reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. Initia's FAQ says iUSD is backed 1:1 by Agora AUSD and that supply expands on deposits and contracts on withdrawals. At interwoven-1 block 21248472 (hash oLp2oqBrLNW+e3Jbsmn+wta6wc9+Qum61EFE+Flexgo=; 2026-08-29T18:49:43.399544346Z), the current iUSD metadata object 0x6c69733a9e722f3660afb524f89fce957801fa7e4408b8ef8fe89db9627b570e has supply 2,511,330.584682 (6 decimals), and the bank supply endpoint reports the same amount. A pinned primary_fungible_store::balance view for owner vault object 0xfd6a07594842ac5d7501ff55243aff06e4f991f320828be05a4590970145e90a and AUSD0 metadata 0x8078cf9fee50e15069402e9d1d9db70b28fc0d5197d79e8a2b41e2ade432efef returns exactly 2,511,330.584682 AUSD0. AUSD0 total supply is 2,511,333.142661, leaving only 2.557979 AUSD0 outside the iUSD vault. Initia reports iUSD collateral held AUSD0, Noble USDC and WETH; shares unmeasured since the 2026-10-23 halt.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Direct iUSD custody is the Initia iusd-vault and AUSD0 OFT contract path. Agora reserve custody and assurance are upstream AUSD facts, not direct wrapper providers or legal safeguards. The current vault resources demonstrate a separate technical account, but the reopened FAQ and resources do not establish enforceable iUSD holder segregation or insolvency protection. Segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation remain unknown.
